name: POST /api/leadflow/meetings - book a meeting and generate its reminder ladder
description:
Books one of the four meeting types and generates the SOP §45 reminder ladder in the same call, so a meeting cannot exist without its reminders.

THE LADDER IS THREE RUNGS WITH DECLARED AUDIENCES (327ca5f6-1d99-4b2c-9e2a-218250f64f45#AC2): 24 hours before to the customer with a reschedule link, 2 hours before to the customer with logistics, and 15 minutes before to the REP ONLY. The audience is stored per rung rather than inferred from the offset, so a rung added later cannot silently inherit the wrong one - and a customer-facing 15-minute reminder is the one that reads as nagging, since they are already on their way.

ONE REMINDER PER RUNG, enforced by a unique constraint on (meeting, offset). Two 24-hour reminders means the customer is told twice.

An unknown meeting type is refused rather than stored, because a type with no duration or buffer cannot be scheduled against a calendar. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A demo is booked and its three-rung ladder generated
NEGATIVE: an unknown meeting type is refused
NEGATIVE: an unparseable start time is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: meeting_type must be one of fit_call, demo, decision_review, onboarding
starts_at must be a valid ISO timestamp
errorCases.when: the start time cannot be parsed. Every reminder is computed from it.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
